<!-- Server -->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(shiny)
library(flexdashboard) # Easy Shiny app setup
library(tidyverse) # Data wrangling
library(plotly) # Interactive plots
library(DT) # Interactive tables

# packages <- c("httr",
#               "xml2",
#               "ssh")

# Get data
# source("get_cytokine_files.R")
load("xlsx_data.Rdata")
load("lod_data.Rdata")

xlsx_files <- names(xlsx_data)

# Get function combines cytokines and lods into one data frame
source("cytokine_data_processing.R")
cytokine_reads <- cytokine_reads_function(file_names = xlsx_files, 
                                          file_data = xlsx_data,
                                          limit_data = lod_data)

# List of cytokines in data
cytokines <- cytokine_reads$cytokines

# LOD data
lods <- cytokine_reads$lods

# Cytokine data
cytokine_data <- cytokine_reads$readings

# File info
file_type <- cytokine_reads$file_info

long_cytokine_data <- cytokine_data %>%
  filter(BARCODE != "SAMPLE ID") %>%
  select(barcode = BARCODE, file_date, date_run, all_of(cytokines)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(barcode, file_date, date_run), 
               names_to = "analyte",
               values_to = "reading") %>%
  left_join(lods, by = c("analyte", "file_date")) %>%
  left_join(file_type, by = "file_date") %>%
  mutate(note = reading,
         reading = as.numeric(reading),
         below_lod = ifelse((note == "ND" | reading < lod) & note != "%MFIe", 1, 0),
         high_var = ifelse(note == "%MFIe", 1, 0),
         file_date = format(file_date, format = "%y-%m-%d"),
         file_date = factor(file_date))

# Means for each cytokine by plate
cytokine_means <- cytokine_reads$means %>%
  mutate(file_date = format(file_date, format = "%y-%m-%d"),
         file_date = factor(file_date),
         analyte = fct_reorder(analyte, cytokine_date_mean, .na_rm = TRUE),
         text = paste0("File Date: ", file_date, "\n", 
                       "Analyte: ", analyte, "\n", 
                       "Log Mean: ", round(cytokine_date_mean, 1))) %>%
  left_join(file_type, by = "file_date") %>%
  filter(cytokine_date_mean != "NaN")

plasma_cytokine_means <- filter(cytokine_means, file_type == "Plasma")

csf_cytokine_means <- filter(cytokine_means, file_type == "CSF")

# Get proportion of observations BLD
plasma_prop_bld <- long_cytokine_data %>%
  filter(file_type == "Plasma") %>%
  select(file_date, analyte, below_lod) %>%
  summarise(sum = sum(below_lod),
            plate_num = n(), 
            .by = c(file_date, analyte)) %>%
  mutate(prop = sum/plate_num * 100,
         text = paste0("File Date: ", file_date, "\n", 
                       "%BLD: ", round(prop, 1), "% (", sum, "/", plate_num, ")"))

csf_prop_bld <- long_cytokine_data %>%
  filter(file_type == "CSF") %>%
  select(file_date, analyte, below_lod) %>%
  summarise(sum = sum(below_lod),
            plate_num = n(), 
            .by = c(file_date, analyte)) %>%
  mutate(prop = sum/plate_num * 100,
         text = paste0("File Date: ", file_date, "\n", 
                       "%BLD: ", round(prop, 1), "% (", sum, "/", plate_num, ")"))

# Get proportion of observations with high variability
plasma_prop_high_var <- long_cytokine_data %>%
  filter(file_type == "Plasma") %>%
  select(file_date, analyte, high_var) %>%
  summarise(sum = sum(high_var),
            plate_num = n(), 
            .by = c(file_date, analyte)) %>%
  mutate(prop = sum/plate_num * 100,
         text = paste0("File Date: ", file_date, "\n", 
                       "%High Var: ", round(prop, 1), "% (", sum, "/", plate_num, ")"))

csf_prop_high_var <- long_cytokine_data %>%
  filter(file_type == "CSF") %>%
  select(file_date, analyte, high_var) %>%
  summarise(sum = sum(high_var),
            plate_num = n(), 
            .by = c(file_date, analyte)) %>%
  mutate(prop = sum/plate_num * 100,
         text = paste0("File Date: ", file_date, "\n", 
                       "%High Var: ", round(prop, 1), "% (", sum, "/", plate_num, ")"))

display_cytokine_data <- long_cytokine_data %>%
  left_join(select(cytokine_means, file_date, analyte, cytokine_date_mean), by = c("file_date", "analyte")) %>%
  mutate(cytokine_date_mean = exp(cytokine_date_mean)) %>%
  # Replace obs below LOD with 1/2*LOD and High Vars with run mean
  mutate(reading = ifelse(below_lod == 1, 0.5*lod, reading),
         reading = ifelse(high_var == 1, cytokine_date_mean, reading),
         reading = as.numeric(reading)) %>%
  select(barcode, file_date, date_run, sample_type = file_type, analyte, reading) %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(barcode, file_date, date_run, sample_type),
              names_from = analyte,
              values_from = reading)

```

```{r set-up-plots}

lod_plot <- function(data){
  ggplot(data, 
         aes(x = file_date, y = prop, fill = file_date, group = file_date, text = text)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", color = "grey40") +
    labs(x = "", y = "% of Obs Below LOD", fill = "Batch Date") +
    facet_wrap(~analyte, ncol = 6) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
    theme_bw() + 
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
}

high_var_plot <- function(data){
  ggplot(data, aes(x = file_date, y = prop, fill = file_date, group = file_date, text = text)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", color = "grey40") +
  labs(x = "", y = "% of Obs with High Var", fill = "Batch Date") +
  facet_wrap(~analyte, ncol = 6) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
}

mean_vals <- function(data){
  ggplot(data, 
         aes(x = analyte, y = cytokine_date_mean, group = file_date, fill = file_date, text = text)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "", y = "Mean Log(Measure)", fill = "Batch Date") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
}

```

Raw Plate Data
=======================================

Column 
---------------------------------------

### Millipore plate data {data-height=800}

```{r select-plate}

selectInput(inputId = "plate_select", 
            label = "Select cytokine plate by run date:",
            choices = display_cytokine_data$date_run,
            multiple = TRUE # Can select multiple plates
            )

output$data <- DT::renderDataTable({
  req(input$plate_select)
  
  # Displayed data
  display_cytokine_data %>% 
    filter(date_run %in% input$plate_select) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(cytokines), ~round(as.numeric(.), 2))) %>%
    DT::datatable(
      rownames = FALSE,
      extensions = "Buttons",
      fillContainer = FALSE,
      options = list(
        scrollX = "500px",
        scrollCollapse = TRUE,
        scrollY = "500px",
        # Show all observations immediately
        pageLength = -1,
        lengthChange = FALSE,
        # Add button download information:
        dom = "Bfrt",   # "B" renders the buttons
        buttons = list(list(extend = "csv", text = "Download CSV"))
      )
    )
})

```

DT::dataTableOutput("data")
